channel.title: The Apprentice
channel.desc: This week, the candidates are off to the Isle of Wight to find nine items associated with the area, and the team that spends the least money on the correct items wins. Following a dismal performance on the same task in Hong Kong, it's a chance for the candidates to redeem themselves. A mad dash to the finish ensures a tight race, and Lord Sugar bids farewell to another candidate.
